## Summary

说明用户问题和本次最小改动。

## Validation

- [ ] format / lint / typecheck
- [ ] relevant unit and invariant tests
- [ ] browser / a11y / performance when behavior changes
- [ ] package and release checks when public surface changes

## Boundaries

- [ ] SourceData remains immutable
- [ ] no raw G2 public escape hatch
- [ ] no credentials or business data
- [ ] public API/schema/dependency/release changes were approved

## Evidence

列出命令结果、视觉证据和残余风险。
